content: Manušor diya ain edde Allar diya ain
Ar Zeruzalemottu aiššede hoekzon Forošiye edde dormiyo aleme Isa loi dola oiye.
Hitara Isar sahabi hoekzone napaki abostat mani hat no duiyore hána háito boiššede deikke.
Foroši okkole, edde hár Ihudi okkole hitarar furana amolottu loti soli aiyedde niyomore maniyore, hitara hat no duiyore hána no há.
Bazarottu aiyore hitara hat ṭeng no duite kissu no há. Hendilla dusora aro bout kissu hitara falon gorede ase, zenneki fiyala, gora edde tamar gala, haṭ falong, in okkolore dúwa.
Toi Foroši okkole edde dormiyo alem okkole hibare suwal goijje: "Furana amolottu loti soli aiyedde niyomore kiyolla tũwar sahabi okkole no maner, kintu hitara aduiya hate ruṭi hár?"
Toi hibaye hitarare zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara munafek okkolor babute nobi Esaiyaye ṭik hoi giye, iyan zendilla leka ase:
"'Ei zatiye ãre hitarar mukor uwottu šorman gore,
kintu hitarar dil ãttu bout dure.
hitara ãre mani sara fũza gore,
hitarar šikka okkol mainšor diya ain okkol.'
Allar hokumgunore bad goriyore, tũwara mainšor rosomore falon goror."

content: Ar hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Oi, Allar hokum bad goriyore tũwarar nizor rosom salu rakibolla tũwarattu kub šundojja rasta ase!
Zendilla Musaye hoiye, 'Ma bafore šorman goro,' ar, 'Ze honokiye nizor baf mare bura hota ho hitare marifela oibo.'
Kintu tũwara ho, honokiye hitar ma otóba bafore ho, 'ãttu ze ziniš loi tolla modot oito, hin kurban' mani Allar hãse kurbani gora oiye.
Hen oile, tũwara hitare hitar baf edde malla hono kissu gorattu bad goror.
Ei bafe tũwara Allar kalamore batil goriyore tũwara ze rosom faiyo hiyanore zari raikko. Aro bout kissu ase tũwara hendilla gorode."

content: Tarfore Isaye manuš okkolore abar ḍakiyore hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara beggune ãr hota funo edde buzo!
En hono kissu nai zin manušor butore zaiyore hitare napak gori fare, bolke zin manušor butottu niyoli aiye hine napak gore.
Zattu funibar han ase, hite funo!"

content: Tarfore Isaye mainšor dolore eri górot góille, hetunot hibar sahabi okkole he mesal kahaniganor manir babute fusar goijje.
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara kissu no buzo? Tũwara buzi no faror ne, hono kissu zin mainšor butore gole hine hitare napak gori no farede?
Kiyollahoile, hin hitar dilot no gole, kintu feṛot za ar tarfore gar bair oi zagoi."

content: Ei hota loi Isaye buzai diye ze, hono ḍoilla hána napak nai.
Hibaye aro hodde,

content.text: "Mainšor butottu zin niyoli aiye, hine manušore napak gore.
Kiyollahoile butottu, manušor dilor butottu, he horaf sinta okkol niyoli aiye: Beššagiri, suri, kun,
zena, lub lalsi, horafi, oinnore hotigora, dúhabazi, bíyaṛa hota, kukiyal, gibod, nizore loi ohonkari gora, bekufai.
Ei horaf in okkol beggun ekzon manušor dilor butottu niyoli aiye edde hitare napak gore."

content: Fonikiyar mayafuwar biššaš
Bade hiba uiṭṭe edde hentu Tiros elehat giye, heṛe hiba ek górot góille. Ar sail hiyan zene honokiye zani no fare, kintu hiba lukai taki no fare.
Ar hehon ek mayafuwa, zattu ek gura zi aiššil edde napak ruhuye fail, Isar babute funiyore aišše edde hibar fõt uite foijje.
He mayafuwawa aššilde Girik zuban hoiya, Siriya-Fonikiyar zormo, toi hibaye Isar hãse foriyad goijje hibaye zene hibar ziyor butottu he napak ruhure bair gori de.
Kintu Isaye hibare hodde,

content.text: "Age futziyainde feṭ bori háok, kiyollahoile futziyaindottu ruṭi loiyore hin kũirore diya hiyan bala no."

content: Toi hibaye zuwab diye edde hodde, "Oi, Malik, kintu kũir okkole o hánar ṭebilottu futziyaindor hánar guragara zin tole fore hin há."
Toi Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Tui endilla hoiyosde hiyanolla, ãi tore hoir, tui za, tor ziyor butottu napak ruh niyoli giyegoi."

content: Ar hibaye górot aiyore dekedde, ziwa bisanat neṛi taikke edde napak ruhuye sari giyegoi.
Ek nafang edde túta manušore Isaye aram goijje
Toi abar, hibaye Tiros eleha sari Sidon šohoror butottu diyore Galil doriyar hãsa hãsi Dekapolis elehar fara okkolot giye.
Heṛe hodun mainše ekzon manušore hibar hãse ainne, ze aššil nafang edde túta, ar hitar uwore hat rakibolla hitara hibar hãse foriyad goijje.
Isaye he manušware mainšor dolottu ek ḍaikka loizaiyore hibaye hitar dui hanot õl diye, ar sef loiyore hitar zilot ḍoille.
Tarfore hibaye asmanor mikka saiyore ek ḍor niyaš felaiye edde hitare hodde,

content.text: "Effata"

content: mani

content.text: "kuli zagoi."

content: Henot hehon manušwar han kula oigiyegoi edde alazilgan eridiya oigiyegoi, ar hite foriškar gori hota howa šuru goijje.
Hibaye hitarare hokum diye zene honokiyore no ho, kintu hibaye zeto no hoito hoiye, heto hitara aro beši gori elan goijje.
Manuš okkole kub beši ammuwak oiye edde tajjuf oiyore hodde, "Hibaye hár ham zin gorer hin bala. Hibaye nafange funefan edde buke hota hoi farefan gorer."
